overview.text: Today's landscape features major industry movements and technical advances across models and inference. Anthropic has priced its initial public offering of Class A common stock. In model releases, Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Neon alongside the availability of Genie 4, while SenseNova Loop 9B emerged as a compact looped model. Researchers introduced several architectural and optimization techniques, including closed-loop LLM quantization design with agents, direct pixel prediction from diffusion transformers to reduce inference complexity, and looped language models that deepen reasoning at compact parameter counts. Additionally, analysis from Epoch AI revealed that agentic inference capacity grew significantly over a year compared to compute capacity. These developments collectively shape the trajectory of efficient model deployment, reasoning architectures, and commercial AI infrastructure.

entries.title: Anthropic prices initial public offering
entries.summary: Today Anthropic, PBC priced its initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
entries.why: Marks a major financial milestone as Anthropic prices its initial public offering of common stock.

entries.title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
entries.summary: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions.
entries.why: Automates post-training quantization recipes to serve large language models at low cost.

entries.title: Gemini 4 Neon
entries.why: Delivers the new Gemini 4 Neon release from Google DeepMind for advanced capabilities.

entries.title: Decoding Without a Decoder: Direct Pixel Prediction from Diffusion Transformers
entries.summary: Latent diffusion models rely on a decoder to map denoised latents to pixels, adding complexity and inference cost. We introduce Decoding Without a Decoder (DWD), which lets a finetuned diffusion transformer produce final pixels directly through a linear head.
entries.why: Eliminates the traditional decoder in latent diffusion models for direct pixel prediction.

entries.title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models
entries.summary: Looped language models deepen reasoning at a compact parameter count by iterating a shared layer stack T times per token, turning recurrence depth directly into sequential decoding latency.
entries.why: Deepens reasoning in compact parameter counts by iterating a shared layer stack.

entries.title: PReMind: When Personal Memory Meets Visual Hazards
entries.summary: Personalized vision-language assistants use visual observations and personal memories to provide advice tailored to the user.
entries.why: Combines personal memory with visual observations for tailored assistant advice.

entries.title: Learning Anisotropic Prediction Targets for Flow Models
entries.summary: Flow-based generative models are trained on a hand-chosen prediction target, such as the velocity, the noise, or the clean data. This choice strongly affects training and sample quality.
entries.why: Explores how hand-chosen prediction targets affect training and sample quality in flow models.

entries.title: SenseNova Loop 9B
entries.summary: If the benchmarks are true, this is a 9B looped model on level with Qwen3.8 27B. They say they'll release gguf tomorrow.
entries.why: Offers a compact looped model competitive with larger parameter alternatives.

entries.title: Solomonoff induction with reflective oracles
entries.summary: Linkpost for https://arxiv.org/html/2611.14454v1 Our PIBBSS fellow Damini Kusum wrote an excellent paper on prediction with reflective oracle Solomonoff Induction (rOSI).…

entries.title: Agentic inference capacity grew 4.6× in a year, versus 2.6× for compute capacity
entries.summary: Our Inference Performance Index and chip sales data show agentic inference capacity grew nearly twice as much as 8-bit compute.
entries.why: Quantifies the rapid growth of agentic inference capacity relative to compute capacity.
